editorial: Before laying out our recommendations, we must acknowledge there’s a whole other side to Malaysia that we left unexplored. If your itinerary includes Borneo, then perhaps our suggestions may not be the most appropriate.

With that out of the way, our recommendation is to visit during the cool and dry season (December to March) along the western coast of the mainland. The pristine skies make it the ideal time for Langkawi in particular.
We visited in August, which is the moderate season (March to August) and were subject to the occasional showers in both KL and Langkawi.
The wetter months (September to November) are best avoided unless getting drenched in persistent rains is your idea of fun.
